sentence: Every mogfather was once someone's sonsei first.

wombos.definition: A respectable friend or mentor figure — someone you look up to who also moves with the energy of a 'son.' The authoritative counterpart to a sonbling.
wombos.example: My sonsei walked in and immediately commanded the whole room.

wombos.definition: The undisputed master of mogging — someone who dominates in appearance or presence so thoroughly that they command respect the way a Godfather commands loyalty.
wombos.example: Nobody steps into the room and owns it like he does — he's the Mogfather.
